_what: The speed gate of the switch-over (owner decision 2026-10-27): on the Lighthouse mobile profile and on the unthrottled 4x-CPU profile, the new "/" LCP is never slower than the old "/". This file is the old build's measurement, the baseline, kept in the repo with the switch-over build measured beside it on the same machine. Judged by scripts/home-speed-gate.mjs; docs/homepage-pricing/README.md, step 15, says how a re-measure is run.

old.what: the old "/" (the scanner page, wave 4's tree as hp/honesty carries it)

switchOver.what: the board-first "/" of the switch-over (the review round's frontend; later commits touch only tests, docs and the ledger)

method.build: a production build (vite build) of a git archive export of each commit, baked under a read-only fetch guard and served the way Lovable resolves paths (a file, then <path>.html, then <path>/index.html, else the root index.html)
method.browser: Playwright 1.62.1, headless Chromium, one fresh context per run, locale en-US
method.lcp: the startTime of the last largest-contentful-paint entry, read after the load event, network idle (up to 20 s) and a further 4 s
method.production: read only: GETs, RPCs re-sent as GETs, job-board reads with x-rb-budget: probe; every other write answered inside the browser (0 on every run)
method.tool: ~/.config/resumebooster/home-pricing-switch-over-2026-10-26/fix-round/tools/lcp2.cjs (with serve.cjs, safe-fetch.cjs and build.sh beside it)

lighthouseMobile.what: Lighthouse's mobile profile (150 ms RTT, 1.6 Mbps down, 750 kbps up, 4x CPU), applied through the DevTools protocol rather than Lighthouse's own simulation

unthrottled4xCpu.what: 4x CPU slowdown, network unthrottled (a local server)

desktop.what: no throttling; kept as the record, not part of the gate

rule: For each case of a gated profile, the median of the new build's runs, rounded to the 0.1 s Lighthouse prints, is no more than the old build's median rounded the same way.
